mapper.insert: INSERT INTO medication_execution (plan_id, elder_id, execution_date, period, status, executed_time, note, create_id, create_time, update_id, update_time) VALUES (#{execution.planId}, #{execution.elderId}, #{execution.executionDate}, #{execution.period}, #{execution.status}, #{execution.executedTime}, #{execution.note}, #{operatorId}, NOW(), #{operatorId}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), status = VALUES(status), executed_time = VALUES(executed_time), note = VALUES(note), update_id = VALUES(update_id), update_time = NOW()
